correctness.rationale: The source positive spectral theorem is applied only under its separable bounded positive hypotheses. The finite-product well-order extraction gives a simultaneous monotone subsequence, hence every Borel monotone image has well-ordered point eigenvalues. Halmos decomposition and the exact identity A_t^2-A_t=-t(1-t)(P-Q)^2 yield two strict opposite spectral branches, whose simultaneous occurrence forces a finite principal-angle spectrum. Finite spectrum gives the converse and finite-dimensional generated algebra. Direct-sum rank-one projection blocks have positive eigenvalues decreasing to zero but zero kernel; geometric Schatten estimates converge for all p>0. Exact rational and numerical checks: 1120 assertions in the embedded standalone checker. Finite checks are not substitutes for infinite proofs.

value.rationale: A natural newly studied reducing-minimum class gets a full closure principle for finite commuting families, including discontinuous monotone functions, and a complete intrinsic algebra/spectrum classification for the elementary noncommuting pair of projections. The all-Schatten arbitrarily-small counterexample shows that this boundary cannot be replaced by perturbative near-commutativity or even ordinary minimum attainment. The result resolves a motivated structural stability question with all mixing weights, rather than an arbitrary small finite computation.
